label: Ingredient
description: Raw ingredients as still-life heroes — the market shot before the cooking starts.

items.name: heirloom-tomatoes
items.text: heirloom tomatoes split and whole, ribbed shoulders in oxblood, zebra-stripe and gold, seed jelly glistening in the cut faces, stems still peppery green

items.name: mackerel-on-ice
items.text: whole mackerel on crushed ice, tiger-striped backs iridescing blue-green, eyes clear and gills scarlet, each scale throwing its own tiny highlight

items.name: citrus-wheels
items.text: a tiling of citrus wheels on white marble, blood orange, pomelo and lime, backlight turning every segment to stained glass

items.name: chocolate-study
items.text: a dark-chocolate still life, snapped bar edges showing crisp temper, curled shavings, cocoa powder drifted like dune sand, one cacao pod split to its pale beans

items.name: honeycomb-slab
items.text: a slab of raw honeycomb on a wooden board, hexagon caps torn open and weeping gold, one slow drip stretching toward the dipper below

items.name: foraged-mushrooms
items.text: foraged mushrooms tumbled from a willow basket, chanterelle pleats and fat porcini caps still dusted with forest soil, a paring knife and brushed-off leaves beside

items.name: spice-pyramids
items.text: spice pyramids heaped in brass bowls, turmeric, smoked paprika and blue-grey poppy seed, a scoop mid-plunge, fine dust hazing the air above

items.name: torn-burrata
items.text: a burrata torn open, cream spilling stracciatella across charred sourdough, olive oil beading on the milky surface, cracked pepper caught in the pool

items.name: dry-aged-ribeye
items.text: a raw dry-aged ribeye on butcher paper, deep burgundy grain under a frost of aged fat, salt crystals just landed and not yet melting

items.name: fresh-herb-bundle
items.text: just-picked herbs bundled with twine, basil, purple sage and flowering thyme, water droplets still standing on the leaves, scissors on the linen beside
